assessment: The authors investigate mechanisms that regulate glycolytic ATP production in neurons. They conclude that the cytosolic Na+, not Ca2+, and the activity of the Na+/K+ pump drive glycolysis. The study is conceptually significant as it seeks to determine how neuronal glycolysis is coupled to electrical activity. The study is thoughtful, uses sophisticated fluorescence lifetime imaging technology and clever experimental designs, and as such provides new insights into how electrical activity regulates glycolysis.
